prompt: Write an email to my client Maria Rossi to let her know the project will be delayed by two weeks due to a dependency issue

assertions.name: language-is-italian
assertions.description: Email body is written in Italian

assertions.name: formal-salutation
assertions.description: Uses a formal Italian salutation (Gentile or Spettabile, not Ciao)

assertions.name: lei-form-used
assertions.description: Uses the formal 'Lei' form (capitalized) throughout, not 'tu'

assertions.name: delay-mentioned
assertions.description: The two-week delay is explicitly mentioned

assertions.name: dependency-reason-mentioned
assertions.description: The dependency issue is cited as the cause of the delay

assertions.name: no-padding-phrases
assertions.description: Does not contain filler phrases like 'spero che questa email la trovi bene' or 'non esiti a contattarmi'

assertions.name: specific-subject-line
assertions.description: Subject line is specific (not generic like 'Aggiornamento' alone)

assertions.name: formal-sign-off
assertions.description: Closes with a formal Italian sign-off (Distinti saluti or Cordiali saluti)
